```{r}
#| context: setup
library(shiny)
library(bslib)
library(leaflet)
library(DT)
library(tidyverse)
library(shinyWidgets)

routes <- read_csv("crags/areas/all_routes.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)

# pre-compute histogram counts used by the mini-bar charts in the sidebar
stars_hist_data <- hist(routes$avg_stars, breaks = seq(1, 4, by = 0.5), plot = FALSE)
grade_hist_data <- hist(routes$grade_int[!is.na(routes$grade_int)],
                        breaks = seq(-0.5, 14.5, by = 1), plot = FALSE)

shiny::shinyOptions(bootstrapTheme = bslib::bs_theme(version = 5L))

grade_colors <- c(
  ## Ropes ----
  "5.3"   = "#1a6e1a", "5.4"   = "#1a6e1a", "5.5"   = "#1a6e1a", "5.7"   = "#1a6e1a",
  "5.8"   = "#4caf50", "5.9"   = "#8bc34a",
  "5.10"  = "#1565c0", "5.10a" = "#1565c0", "5.10b" = "#1976d2",
  "5.10c" = "#64b5f6", "5.10d" = "#64b5f6",
  "5.11"  = "#e65100", "5.11a" = "#e65100", "5.11b" = "#ef6c00",
  "5.11c" = "#ffb74d", "5.11d" = "#ffb74d",
  "5.12"  = "#c62828", "5.12b" = "#c62828", "5.14a" = "#c62828",
  ## Bouldering ----
  "v0"    = "#1a6e1a", "v1"    = "#4caf50", "v2"    = "#8bc34a",
  "v3"    = "#1565c0", "v4"    = "#1976d2", "v5"    = "#64b5f6",
  "v6"    = "#e65100", "v7"    = "#ef6c00", "v8"    = "#ffb74d",
  "v9"    = "#c62828", "v10"   = "#c62828", "v11"   = "#c62828",
  "v12"   = "#c62828", "v13"   = "#c62828"
)


grade_range <- range(routes$grade_int, na.rm = TRUE)
star_range  <- range(routes$avg_stars,  na.rm = TRUE)

# ── Helpers ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

# Returns the column name to group by at the current drill depth
get_group_col <- function(path) {
  switch(as.character(length(path)),
    "0" = "area", "1" = "region_1", "2" = "region_2", "3" = "region_3", "route"
  )
}

# Filters df down to the rows matching the current drill path
apply_drill <- function(df, path) {
  if (length(path) >= 1) df <- df |> filter(area     == path[[1]]$value)
  if (length(path) >= 2) df <- df |> filter(region_1 == path[[2]]$value)
  if (length(path) >= 3) df <- df |> filter(region_2 == path[[3]]$value)
  if (length(path) >= 4) df <- df |> filter(region_3 == path[[4]]$value)
  df
}
```

```{r}
#| context: server

# ── One-time JS ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
observe({
  insertUI("body", "beforeEnd", immediate = TRUE, ui = tags$script(HTML('
    // Geolocation
    if (navigator.geolocation) {
      navigator.geolocation.getCurrentPosition(function(pos) {
        Shiny.setInputValue("user_lat", pos.coords.latitude);
        Shiny.setInputValue("user_lng", pos.coords.longitude);
      });
    }

    // Force sidebar overflow hidden – jQuery finds the element regardless of exact class
    $(document).ready(function() {
      $("aside, nav").css({ overflow: "hidden", maxWidth: "100%" });
      $("aside .shiny-input-container").css({ maxWidth: "100%" });
    });

    // Scroll DataTable to the row matching a route_id and highlight it
    Shiny.addCustomMessageHandler("highlight_dt_row", function(msg) {
      setTimeout(function() {
        var tbl = $("#data_table").DataTable();
        if (!tbl) return;
        var lastCol = tbl.columns().count() - 1;
        var found   = -1;
        tbl.rows().every(function(i) {
          if (String(this.data()[lastCol]) === String(msg.route_id)) found = i;
        });
        tbl.rows().nodes().to$().css("background-color", "");
        if (found >= 0) {
          var page = Math.floor(found / tbl.page.info().length);
          tbl.page(page).draw(false);
          $(tbl.row(found).node()).css("background-color", "#fff3cd");
        }
      }, 250);
    });
  ')))
})

# ── Reactive state ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
drill_path        <- reactiveVal(list())
bar_region_sel    <- reactiveVal(NULL)
map_bounds_rv     <- reactiveVal(NULL)
selected_route_id <- reactiveVal(NULL)

map_bounds_deb <- reactive(input$map_bounds) |> debounce(300)
observe({ map_bounds_rv(map_bounds_deb()) })

observeEvent(input$reset_all, {
  drill_path(list())
  bar_region_sel(NULL)
  selected_route_id(NULL)
  leafletProxy("map") |> clearGroup("highlight")
})

# ── Sidebar filter ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
filtered_data <- reactive({
  df <- routes |>
    mutate(color = map_chr(grade_simple, ~grade_colors[.x]))

  if (length(input$climb_type) > 0) {
    mask <- Reduce(`|`, lapply(input$climb_type, \(col) df[[col]] == 1))
    df   <- df[mask, ]
  }

  df |> filter(
    avg_stars  >= input$stars[1], avg_stars  <= input$stars[2],
    !is.na(grade_int),
    grade_int  >= input$grade[1], grade_int  <= input$grade[2]
  )
})

# Route list: sidebar + map bounds + drill context
display_data <- reactive({
  df     <- filtered_data()
  bounds <- map_bounds_rv()

  if (!is.null(bounds)) {
    df <- df |> filter(
      !is.na(x), !is.na(y),
      x >= bounds$west,  x <= bounds$east,
      y >= bounds$south, y <= bounds$north
    )
  }

  apply_drill(df, drill_path())
})

# ── Sidebar mini-histograms (HTML flex bars – no plotOutput sizing issues) ────
make_hist_ui <- function(h, sel) {
  max_count <- max(h$counts)
  bars <- lapply(seq_along(h$counts), function(i) {
    in_range <- h$mids[i] >= sel[1] & h$mids[i] <= sel[2]
    color    <- if (in_range) "#5b9bd5" else "#d0d0d0"
    h_pct    <- max(4, round(h$counts[i] / max_count * 100))
    tags$div(style = sprintf(
      "flex:1; height:%d%%; background:%s; margin:0 1px; border-radius:2px 2px 0 0;",
      h_pct, color
    ))
  })
  tags$div(
    style = "width:100%; height:45px; display:flex; align-items:flex-end; margin-bottom:4px;",
    tagList(bars)
  )
}

output$stars_hist <- renderUI(make_hist_ui(stars_hist_data, input$stars))
output$grade_hist <- renderUI(make_hist_ui(grade_hist_data, input$grade))

# ── Map ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
output$map <- renderLeaflet({
  leaflet() |> addProviderTiles("CartoDB.Positron") |> setView(lng = -82, lat = 37, zoom = 6)
})

observe({
  zoom  <- input$map_zoom
  df    <- filtered_data() |> filter(!is.na(x), !is.na(y))
  proxy <- leafletProxy("map") |> clearGroup("routes")

  if (input$aggregate) {
    agg_col <- if (is.null(zoom) || zoom < 7) "region_1"
               else if (zoom < 10)            "region_2"
               else if (zoom < 13)            "region_3"
               else                           NULL

    if (!is.null(agg_col)) {
      # Include parent columns so we can color by bar_region_sel at any level
      # e.g. when sel = {col: "area", value: "WV"}, color all region_1 points in WV
      group_cols <- switch(agg_col,
        region_1 = c("area", "region_1"),
        region_2 = c("area", "region_1", "region_2"),
        region_3 = c("area", "region_1", "region_2", "region_3")
      )

      agg_df <- df |>
        group_by(across(all_of(group_cols))) |>
        summarise(cx = mean(x), cy = mean(y), n = n(), .groups = "drop") |>
        mutate(
          agg_label = .data[[agg_col]],
          layer_id  = paste0("__agg__|", agg_col, "|", row_number())
        )

      # Color aggregated points: blue if they belong to the selected region, grey otherwise
      sel <- bar_region_sel()
      agg_colors <- if (!is.null(sel) && sel$col %in% names(agg_df)) {
        ifelse(agg_df[[sel$col]] == sel$value, "#1565c0", "#aaaaaa")
      } else {
        rep("#aaaaaa", nrow(agg_df))
      }

      proxy |> addCircleMarkers(
        data        = agg_df, lng = ~cx, lat = ~cy,
        layerId     = ~layer_id, group = "routes",
        radius      = ~pmin(8 + sqrt(n) * 2, 35),
        color       = agg_colors,
        fillColor   = agg_colors,
        fillOpacity = 0.6, stroke = TRUE, weight = 2,
        label       = ~paste0(agg_label, ": ", n, " routes")
      )
      return()
    }
  }

  # Individual markers – always colored by grade
  colors <- ifelse(is.na(df$color), "#888888", df$color)

  popup_html <- paste0(
    "<b>", df$route, "</b><br>",
    "Grade: ", df$grade, " | Stars: ", df$avg_stars, "<br>",
    df$region_1, " › ", df$region_2, " › ", df$region_3,
    "<br><a href='", df$url, "' target='_blank'>Mountain Project ↗</a>"
  )

  proxy |> addCircleMarkers(
    data        = df, lng = ~x, lat = ~y,
    layerId     = ~as.character(route_id), group = "routes",
    radius      = 6,
    color       = colors, fillColor = colors,
    fillOpacity = 0.85, stroke = TRUE, weight = 1,
    popup       = popup_html
  )
})

# Map clicks only zoom in – selection state is driven by the freq table
observeEvent(input$map_marker_click, {
  click <- input$map_marker_click
  lid   <- click$id

  if (startsWith(lid, "__agg__|")) {
    parts   <- strsplit(lid, "\\|")[[1]]
    agg_col <- parts[2]
    zoom_in <- switch(agg_col, region_1 = 8, region_2 = 10, region_3 = 12, 8)
    leafletProxy("map") |> flyTo(lng = click$lng, lat = click$lat, zoom = zoom_in)
  } else {
    leafletProxy("map") |> flyTo(lng = click$lng, lat = click$lat, zoom = 14)
  }
})

# User location – separate group so clearGroup("routes") leaves it intact
observeEvent(list(input$user_lat, input$user_lng), {
  req(input$user_lat, input$user_lng)
  leafletProxy("map") |>
    setView(lng = input$user_lng, lat = input$user_lat, zoom = 8) |>
    addCircleMarkers(
      lng = input$user_lng, lat = input$user_lat,
      layerId = "user_location", group = "user",
      radius = 10, color = "black", fillColor = "black",
      fillOpacity = 0.9, stroke = TRUE, weight = 3,
      popup = "You are here"
    )
})

# ── Route Frequency table (DT) ────────────────────────────────────────────────
all_types <- c(boulder_ind = "Boulder", sport_ind = "Sport",
               tr_ind = "Top Rope",    trad_ind  = "Trad")

# Freq table data: no bounds filter so map pan/zoom never resets it
freq_table_df <- reactive({
  path       <- drill_path()
  df         <- apply_drill(filtered_data(), path)
  col        <- get_group_col(path)
  shown_cols <- if (length(input$climb_type) == 0) names(all_types)
                else intersect(input$climb_type, names(all_types))
  friendly   <- unname(all_types[shown_cols])

  df |>
    group_by(Region = .data[[col]]) |>
    summarise(
      Boulder    = sum(boulder_ind, na.rm = TRUE),
      Sport      = sum(sport_ind,   na.rm = TRUE),
      `Top Rope` = sum(tr_ind,      na.rm = TRUE),
      Trad       = sum(trad_ind,    na.rm = TRUE),
      Total      = n(),
      .groups    = "drop"
    ) |>
    arrange(Region) |>
    select(Region, all_of(friendly), Total)
})

output$freq_table <- renderDT({
  df        <- freq_table_df()
  path      <- drill_path()
  col       <- get_group_col(path)
  can_drill <- !col %in% c("region_3", "route")

  datatable(
    df,
    rownames  = FALSE,
    selection = "single",
    caption   = if (can_drill) tags$caption(
      style = "caption-side:bottom; font-size:0.78em; color:#888;",
      "Click to highlight on map  \u2022  Double-click to drill in"
    ) else NULL,
    options = list(
      pageLength   = 20,
      dom          = "tip",
      initComplete = JS("function(settings, json) {
        var api = this.api();
        $(api.table().body()).on('dblclick', 'tr', function() {
          var data = api.row(this).data();
          if (data) Shiny.setInputValue('freq_table_dblclick', data[0], {priority: 'event'});
        });
      }")
    )
  )
})

# Clickable breadcrumb: each segment navigates back to that drill depth
output$drill_breadcrumb <- renderUI({
  path   <- drill_path()
  labels <- c("Area", sapply(path, `[[`, "value"))
  n      <- length(labels)

  parts <- lapply(seq_len(n), function(i) {
    if (i == n) {
      tags$span(style = "font-size:0.8em; font-weight:600;", labels[i])
    } else {
      depth <- i - 1L
      tags$a(
        href    = "#",
        style   = "font-size:0.8em; color:#0d6efd; text-decoration:none;",
        onclick = sprintf(
          "Shiny.setInputValue('bc_click', %d, {priority:'event'}); return false;", depth),
        labels[i]
      )
    }
  })

  seps <- rep(list(tags$span(style = "color:#888; margin:0 4px;", "\u203a")), n - 1)
  interleaved <- vector("list", 2 * n - 1)
  for (i in seq_len(n)) {
    interleaved[[2 * i - 1]] <- parts[[i]]
    if (i < n) interleaved[[2 * i]] <- seps[[i]]
  }
  div(style = "display:inline;", tagList(interleaved))
})

observeEvent(input$bc_click, {
  depth <- as.integer(input$bc_click)
  drill_path(drill_path()[seq_len(depth)])
  bar_region_sel(NULL)
})

# Single-click: highlight matching aggregated points on the map (no drill)
observeEvent(input$freq_table_rows_selected, {
  sel <- input$freq_table_rows_selected
  if (length(sel) == 0) { bar_region_sel(NULL); return() }
  row <- isolate(freq_table_df())[sel[1], ]
  col <- get_group_col(isolate(drill_path()))
  bar_region_sel(list(col = col, value = row$Region))
})

# Double-click: highlight + advance drill (if not at region_3) + zoom map to centroid
# At region_3 level: zoom to 13 to reveal individual routes without drilling further
observeEvent(input$freq_table_dblclick, {
  val  <- input$freq_table_dblclick
  if (is.null(val) || val == "") return()
  path <- isolate(drill_path())
  col  <- get_group_col(path)
  if (col == "route") return()

  bar_region_sel(list(col = col, value = val))

  if (col != "region_3") {
    drill_path(c(path, list(list(level = col, value = val))))
  }

  routes_in <- isolate(filtered_data()) |>
    filter(!is.na(x), !is.na(y), .data[[col]] == val)
  if (nrow(routes_in) > 0) {
    zoom <- switch(col, area = 7, region_1 = 9, region_2 = 10, region_3 = 13, 14)
    leafletProxy("map") |>
      flyTo(lng = mean(routes_in$x), lat = mean(routes_in$y), zoom = zoom)
  }
})

# ── Data table ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
table_df <- reactive({
  display_data() |> arrange(desc(avg_stars))
})

output$data_table <- renderDT({
  df <- table_df() |>
    mutate(Route = paste0('<a href="', url, '" target="_blank">', route, '</a>')) |>
    select(Route, Grade = grade, Stars = avg_stars,
           `Region 1` = region_1, `Region 2` = region_2, `Region 3` = region_3,
           route_id)

  datatable(
    df,
    escape    = FALSE,
    rownames  = FALSE,
    selection = "single",
    options   = list(
      pageLength  = 8,
      scrollX     = TRUE,
      columnDefs  = list(list(visible = FALSE, targets = ncol(df) - 1))
    )
  ) |> formatRound("Stars", digits = 1)
})

# Table row click → highlight ring only, no zoom
observeEvent(input$data_table_rows_selected, {
  sel <- input$data_table_rows_selected
  leafletProxy("map") |> clearGroup("highlight")
  if (length(sel) == 0) return()

  row <- isolate(table_df())[sel[1], ]
  req(!is.na(row$x), !is.na(row$y))

  leafletProxy("map") |>
    addCircleMarkers(
      lng = row$x, lat = row$y,
      layerId = "highlight_marker", group = "highlight",
      radius = 18, color = "black", fillColor = "transparent",
      fillOpacity = 0, stroke = TRUE, weight = 3
    )
})
```
